description: Controlled 3-channel SNUNet source ablation study incorporating physical metric terrain slope [VV, VH, slope]. Replicated with random seed 1 under Week 3 replication protocol.

provenance_clarification.scientific_role: Controlled topographic ablation study evaluating whether local terrain gradient aids flood discrimination and mountain shadow suppression.
provenance_clarification.official_checkpoint_relationship: Model B does NOT claim that slope was the official checkpoint's third channel. The official checkpoint third channel remains completely UNKNOWN.

sar_preprocessing_order: 1. clamp raw linear amplitude to [sar_clamp_min, sar_clamp_max]

slope_policy.crs_requirement: Projected metric CRS; fail loudly if CRS spacing is in geographic degrees
slope_policy.pixel_spacing_rule: Read pixel spacing dx, dy dynamically from each DEM GeoTIFF transform; observe 10m spacing as empirical data, do not blindly hard-code
slope_policy.nodata_sanitization: Identify nodata from GeoTIFF metadata and values < -1000m via kuro_dem_sanitize_v1; compute slope only over valid elevation support to prevent artificial boundary cliffs
slope_policy.invalid_slope_treatment: Replace invalid slope pixels with train-set slope mean before normalization, yielding 0.0 after z-score standardization
slope_policy.normalization_scope: Strictly 22 inner-train events only; zero TTA-val or test data

loss_specification.name: unweighted_ce_plus_soft_dice
loss_specification.formula: total_loss = 0.5 * cross_entropy(logits, target, ignore_index=3) + 0.5 * mean_soft_dice_loss(softmax(logits), target, classes=[0,1,2], ignore_index=3, eps=1.0)
loss_specification.absent_class_handling: Smooth Dice with eps=1.0 ensures denominator is strictly positive and numerator equals eps when ground truth has zero pixels for class c, producing stable zero loss for correct absence and smooth bounded gradients for false alarms.

batch_size_policy.accumulation_loss_semantics: Gradient accumulation gives an effective optimization batch of 32, but the Soft Dice denominator is evaluated per physical microbatch of 8. The measured difference from a full-batch Dice calculation was approximately 0.36% in the controlled equivalence test.

launch_block_reasons: Formal canonical training blocked until Gate 1 (automated unit tests) and Gate 2 (FP32 bounded smoke tests) pass and are committed.
